title: Contour Map

serves.summary: The learner drags a flag or tent onto a contour map to mark the highest ground, the steepest slope, or flat ground, which shows they can read contour lines for height and steepness.

request.topic: Reading contour lines on a topographic map
request.objective: Read contour lines for height and steepness: lines close together mean steep ground, lines far apart mean flat ground, and the innermost closed line is the top (SCI004-05-a)

problems.ask: Plant the flag on the highest ground on the map.
problems.goal: The flag is inside the innermost line, the 50 m line.

problems.ask: Plant the flag on the steepest part of the hill.
problems.goal: The flag is on the west slope, where the lines are closest together.

problems.ask: Pitch the tent on flat ground that is higher than 40 m.
problems.goal: The tent is on the shelf between the 60 m and 50 m lines, where the lines are far apart.

problems.ask: Plant the flag on the steepest slope on the map.
problems.goal: The flag is on the east side of the lower hill, where the lines are closest together.
